record.paper_title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities
record.original_question: For a given matrix norm ||·||, does there exist a best dimension-independent constant C such that for all matrices X, Y, and Z one has ||X||+||Y||+||Z||-||X+Y+Z|| ≤ C[(||X||+||Y||-||X+Y||)+(||X||+||Z||-||X+Z||)+(||Y||+||Z||-||Y+Z||)]? In particular, what is the optimal constant C_p when the norm is the Schatten p-norm?

evidence.quote:
Problem 7 Find the best (dimension-independent) constant C – if it exists –
such that
||X|| + ||Y || + ||Z|| − ||X + Y + Z||
≤ C{(||X|| + ||Y || − ||X + Y ||) +
(||X|| + ||Z|| − ||X + Z||) +
(||Y || + ||Z|| − ||Y + Z||)} (48)
In particular, find the best constant Cp when the norm in question is the Schatten
p-norm.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\|\cdot\|$ be a matrix norm on (a suitable space of) complex matrices. Define the Hlawka-type defect of a triple $(X,Y,Z)$ by
$$H(X,Y,Z) := \|X\|+\|Y\|+\|Z\|-\|X+Y+Z\|,$$
and the pairwise triangle defects by
$$T(A,B) := \|A\|+\|B\|-\|A+B\|.$$
Determine whether there exists a finite, dimension-independent constant $C$ such that for all matrices $X, Y, Z$ of any common size,
$$H(X,Y,Z) \le C\bigl[T(X,Y)+T(X,Z)+T(Y,Z)\bigr],$$
and, if so, find the smallest such constant. In particular, for each $p \in [1,\infty]$, determine the smallest such constant $C_p$ when $\|\cdot\|$ is the Schatten $p$-norm $\|A\|_p = \bigl(\mathrm{tr}\,(A^*A)^{p/2}\bigr)^{1/p}$.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of this Hlawka-type complementary inequality for matrix norms or for the Schatten $p$-norms with explicit best constants $C_p$. While related Hlawka and parallelogram-type inequalities for Schatten classes have been studied, the specific best-constant question appears not to have a verified solution in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Schatten p-norm inequalities related to an extended operator parallelogram law
status_evidence.snippet: Generalizations of the parallelogram law for Schatten p-norms.
status_evidence.claim: Related Schatten p-norm inequalities exist but do not resolve the best constant in the Hlawka complementary inequality.
